steps.title: Ordering a meal
steps.html:
WhoWhat they say
WaiterWould you like to order? · Would you like any side dishes? · Anything else?
CustomerCould I have the fish, please? · Can I have some rice? · I'd like the salad.
Saying noNo, thanks. Just a main course, please.
AskingCan we pay by card? · Could we have the bill, please?

I'd like is the short form of I would like. It is more polite than I want.

After would like and could have the verb or noun follows directly: I'd like some water.

Learners often say I want the chicken. In a restaurant that sounds rude — use Could I have…

Practical detailYou don't need to call them and book.
